scripts.build:core: cmake -S core -B build/core -G Ninja -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release && cmake --build build/core
scripts.build:bridge: cmake -S schema/cpp -B build/bridge -G Ninja -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release && cmake --build build/bridge
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p schema && tsc -p cloud && tsc -p evals && tsc -p ui && tsc -p library
scripts.test: npm run test:core && npm run test:bridge && npm run --workspaces --if-present test
